title: ATDD Worker Checkpoint
description: Per-session worker state captured after a phase transition. Lives at .atdd/worker-state-{issue}.json (gitignored). Source: issue #378.

issue.description: GitHub issue number this checkpoint belongs to

phase.description: ATDD lifecycle phase the worker had just completed when the checkpoint was written

branch.description: Git branch the worker was operating on

last_commit.description: Short SHA of the last commit on the branch when the checkpoint was written

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what the worker just finished (≤500 chars; longer values are truncated by the writer)

open_files.description: Files the worker had open / was actively editing when the checkpoint was written

ttl_seconds.description: Advisory TTL — older checkpoints SHOULD be ignored by --from-checkpoint
